FN-W8AP999-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 211
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Jaime Kiel
Security
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/18/2024
House Bill 211 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain citing agencies by a
small, undetermined amount dependent on the cost to notify a parent, legal guardian, or legal
custodian of a minor issued a traffic citation.
